name: calibre-web
title: Calibre-Web
description: Browse, read, and download your Calibre ebook library

defaultEnv.description: User ID Calibre-Web runs as; the library and config files are owned by this UID. Match the host user that owns the app data dir.
defaultEnv.label: User ID (PUID)

defaultEnv.description: Group ID Calibre-Web runs as. Match the host group that owns the app data dir.
defaultEnv.label: Group ID (PGID)

defaultEnv.description: Timezone used for timestamps, e.g. America/New_York.
defaultEnv.label: Timezone
Enable ebook format conversion
defaultEnv.description: Installs Calibre's command-line tools at container start so Calibre-Web can convert between ebook formats on download. Adds roughly a minute to first boot and several hundred MB, and is x86-64 only. Kobo EPUB→KEPUB conversion does NOT need this — kepubify ships in the image already.

defaultEnv.label: OPDS/Kobo access password
defaultEnv.description: /opds and /kobo/ can't go through Hola's SSO login — e-reader apps and Kobo devices can't follow that redirect — so Traefik gates those two paths with this credential instead (see auth.forwardAuth.protectedBypassPaths). Fixed username is `hola`. Configure your OPDS reader or Kobo's api_endpoint with https://hola:<this password>@<app host>/... — most OPDS clients and Kobo's firmware both accept credentials embedded in the URL this way.

push.label: Calibre library
push.description: Your Calibre library folder — the one containing metadata.db. Push it again after adding books or fixing metadata in desktop Calibre; only the changes transfer.
